description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing LLM Cost records, exposing RESTful CRUD endpoints with tenant scoping enforcement, Swagger documentation, and middleware for authentication and tenant validation.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Configures middleware for authentication, tenant requirement, scope enforcement, and response headers including tenant info and model collection name.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing LLM cost records, supporting filtering, sorting, pagination, and tenant scoping.

methods.name: router.get('/:id')
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving a single LLM cost record by ID, with tenant validation.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST request for creating a new LLM cost record scoped to the tenant.

methods.name: router.put('/:id')
methods.description: Handles PUT request for updating an existing LLM cost record by ID, enforcing tenant scope.

methods.name: router.delete('/:id')
methods.description: Handles DELETE request for removing an LLM cost record by ID, with tenant validation.
